title: Typewriter
description: Revolver's liner credits on a sheet of cream bond rolled around a typewriter platen, nothing else of the machine but the ribbon guide. Every key bites the paper with its own worn, uneven ink; Return throws the carriage home and rolls the platen.
intent: The machine pared back to the paper and the platen so the strike is the subject: real strikes on real paper, every letter landing a little differently, the carriage moving with weight.
